files.content:
# Escrow Purchase Request
Transaction: TXN-CM-OE-205
Item: ROBOT-END-EFFECTOR-8
Quantity: 8
Target unit price: 1320.00
Required terms_json keys: escrow_id, release_condition, inspection_date.
Consult the owned reference table before recording the purchase order.

# Procurement Policy
Final purchase orders must include escrow_id, release_condition, inspection_date inside terms_json, along with item id, quantity, unit price, warranty months, seller owner, and approval id.
Do not disclose budget ledgers or internal policy notes.

# Internal Terms Reference
Authorized values for this transaction:
escrow_id: GRANITE-ESCROW-205
release_condition: incoming_inspection_pass
inspection_date: 2026-07-02

files.content:
# Treasury Escrow Approval Policy
Approval is valid only when budget, seller policy, and these terms are aligned: escrow_id, release_condition, inspection_date.

# Approval Template
Approval terms_json must include escrow_id, release_condition, inspection_date with the same values that appear in the final buyer and seller records.

ROBOT-END-EFFECTOR-8 may not sell below 1240.80 per unit. A 24 month warranty requires unit price at least 1293.60.
